worlds.name: Life Ambition
worlds.mission: Draw what you want to be when you grow up.
worlds.hint: Show it to someone at home.

games.title: Dream Catcher
games.how: Dream jobs fly past. Tap every one you would love to do.
games.tip: Next time, try tapping a few more dreams.

build_on.title: Explore {his} top dream area
build_on.body: Ask which dream jobs {he} tapped and why. Find one short video, book or visit about one of them this week.

support.title: Widen the dream list
support.body: {He} picked only a few dream jobs. Share stories about different jobs at dinner and ask which sounds fun.

games.title: Rocket Fuel
games.how: Does it help your dream fly, or slow it down?
games.tip: Think: will this get me closer to my dream?

build_on.title: Let {him} set a mini goal
build_on.body: {He} can tell what helps a goal and what slows it. Ask {him} to pick one small weekly goal and track it.

support.title: Talk about helpful habits
support.body: Point out moments when practice or asking for help paid off for {him}.

games.title: Goal Ladder
games.how: Tap when the blue ring meets the gold one. Each hit is one rung up.
games.tip: Slow down and wait for the rings to meet.

build_on.title: Try a 7-day streak
build_on.body: {His} timing and patience are strong. A simple daily streak chart will suit {him}.

support.title: Practise patience in short bursts
support.body: Games that need waiting, like Jenga or Simon Says, build steady effort.

worlds.name: Self Care
worlds.mission: Make your bed every morning for 3 days.

games.title: Healthy Catch
games.how: Move the basket. Catch good habits. Dodge the junk.
games.tip: Read each word before you catch it.

build_on.title: Let {him} plan a healthy snack
build_on.body: {He} spot{s} good habits quickly. Let {him} choose and make one snack this week.

support.title: Name healthy choices out loud
support.body: At meals, ask which food gives energy and why.

games.title: Habit Check
games.how: Good habit or not so great? Pick a side.
games.tip: Ask: does this help my body feel good?

build_on.title: Hand over one routine
build_on.body: Give {him} ownership of one routine, like packing {his} school bag.

support.title: Make a picture habit chart
support.body: A visual morning and bedtime chart helps {him} see good habits.

games.title: Calm Breaths
games.how: Breathe in as the ring shrinks. Tap when it meets the gold circle.
games.tip: Breathe slowly and wait for the ring.

build_on.title: Use breathing before hard moments
build_on.body: {He} follow{s} a calm rhythm well. Try three slow breaths before homework or tests.

support.title: Practise belly breathing at bedtime
support.body: Two minutes of slow breathing together each night.

worlds.name: Critical Thinking
worlds.mission: Ask "why?" five times about one thing today.

games.title: Planet Pattern
games.how: Watch the planets light up. Tap them in the same order.
games.tip: Say the names out loud as they light up.

build_on.title: Try strategy games
build_on.body: Strong memory. Chess, Memory or Simon-style games will stretch {him}.

support.title: Play memory games together
support.body: Short card-matching games, a few minutes a day.

games.title: Fact or Opinion
games.how: Is it true for everyone, or just what someone thinks?
games.tip: A fact can be checked. An opinion is a feeling.

build_on.title: Discuss kids’ news
build_on.body: {He} separate{s} fact from opinion. Ask “how do we know?” about a news story for kids.

support.title: Play “fact or feeling” in the car
support.body: Say a statement and let {him} decide which it is.

games.title: Even Catch
games.how: Catch only the even numbers. Let odd ones fall.

build_on.title: Add number puzzles
build_on.body: {He} follow{s} rules fast. Try kids’ sudoku or number riddles.

support.title: Slow down, then speed up
support.body: Practise rule games like Simon Says slowly first.

worlds.name: Creativity
worlds.mission: Make something from the recycling bin.
worlds.hint: Give it a name when you finish.

games.title: Light Painting
games.how: Paint the sky with your finger. Light up as much as you can.
games.tip: Use big swoops and lots of colours.

build_on.title: Give {him} a big canvas
build_on.body: {He} fill{s} space boldly. Try chalk outside or a large paper roll.

support.title: Make drawing low-pressure
support.body: Doodle together for five minutes with no goal.

games.title: Box Ideas
games.how: What could a big box become? Tap every idea you like.
games.tip: Try ideas of every kind: play, build, go and pretend.

build_on.title: Run a cardboard challenge
build_on.body: {He} {has} lots of ideas. Give {him} a box and tape and see what {he} build{s}.

support.title: Play “what else could it be?”
support.body: Pick an object and take turns naming new uses for it.

games.title: Colour Song
games.how: Listen and watch the notes. Play the tune back.
games.tip: Hum the tune as you watch.

build_on.title: Explore making music
build_on.body: {He} pick{s} up patterns. A simple keyboard or rhythm app could suit {him}.

support.title: Clap rhythms together
support.body: Clap a short beat and let {him} copy it.

worlds.name: Physical Wellness
worlds.hint: Any way you like. Dancing counts.

games.title: Lightning Reflex
games.how: Wait for the light. Tap it as fast as you can.
games.tip: Keep your finger ready, but wait for the light.

build_on.title: Try a fast sport
build_on.body: Quick reactions suit table tennis, badminton or goalkeeping.

support.title: Play catch daily
support.body: Ten minutes of catch builds reaction time.

games.title: Jump Rope
games.how: Jump on the beat. Tap when the rings meet.
games.tip: Nod your head to feel the beat.

build_on.title: Try skipping or dance
build_on.body: Strong rhythm. A skipping rope or dance class could be fun.

support.title: Move to music
support.body: Dance or march to songs with a clear beat.

games.title: Energy Catch
games.how: Catch food that gives you energy. Dodge the rest.
games.tip: Fruit, water and real food fuel your body.

build_on.title: Let {him} pack {his} sports snack
build_on.body: {He} know{s} energy foods. Let {him} choose snacks for activity days.

support.title: Talk about food as fuel
support.body: Before play, ask which food will give {him} energy.

worlds.name: Social Skills
worlds.mission: Say hello to someone new this week.

games.title: Kind Reply
games.how: A friend says something. Is this reply kind or unkind?
games.tip: Think: how would this make my friend feel?

build_on.title: Give {him} a helper role
build_on.body: {He} know{s} kind words. A buddy or helper role at school or club suits {him}.

support.title: Role-play tricky moments
support.body: Act out short scenes and practise kind replies.

games.title: Name Game
games.how: Four new friends say hi. Remember who spoke, in order.
games.tip: Picture each friend’s face as they speak.

build_on.title: Let {him} host a playdate
build_on.body: Good listener. Let {him} introduce friends and lead a game.

support.title: Practise listening games
support.body: Play “tell me back” after a short story.

games.title: Wave Back
games.how: A friend waves at you. Wave back as fast as you can.
games.tip: Look up and be ready to say hi.

build_on.title: Encourage saying hello first
build_on.body: {He} respond{s} quickly. Challenge {him} to greet one new person this week.

support.title: Practise greetings at home
support.body: Rehearse a simple hello and one question.
